sermon.title: Winning at the Christian life - May 5, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: Israel reached the promised land in about a year and four months; the forty years came from complaining. The message draws steps to success from Moses’ charge to Joshua: God is with you, be strong in the Lord, be courageous like Moses, do not fear, do not be dismayed, go with Christ’s authority, and meditate on the word day and night.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: He cites “Deuteronomy chapter 8 verse 1” for the forty years (8:2); left as said and linked to 8:2. The recording places the message first and a worship set after it (~53:12).

faqs.question: Why take the handout home?
faqs.answer: So you can pray over it at your pace and let the word sink in.

faqs.question: Did Joshua and Caleb complain?
faqs.answer: No; they didn’t say, you’re a stinky God, I don’t like you.

faqs.question: Does the speaker have authority over you?
Why does he need joy?
faqs.answer: He has kids to take to school and provide for; he doesn’t have time to grieve.

faqs.question: Does God give up when we doubt?
faqs.answer: No; He’ll pull you back up.

faqs.question: What kind of teaching do we need?
faqs.answer: Transformative; we can’t just open Genesis 1 without praying.

faqs.question: How can we get the word?
faqs.answer: Phones, apps, Amazon, or a Bible from the church.

faqs.question: Can I join the worship team?
faqs.answer: Yes; they want flutes, trumpets and more instruments.
